module.name: navigation-menu
module.title: NavigationMenu
module.description: The NavigationMenu renderer and its options.

ui.name: navigation-menu
ui.summary: Renders a labelled group of boosted navigation links.
ui.guidance: These are anchors, not role="menuitem": a menu promises arrow-key navigation and a menu button, while this is a list of links a user tabs through. The honest role is what a screen reader can act on.
